# Digital twin run — Transformation program (workflow + AI + staffing)

*Model: `TWIN-BASE-10B` v1.0 (2026-07) — Archetype IDN — $10B NPR, single-instance Epic on AWS, Snowflake EDW, Databricks lakehouse. Horizon 36 months. Generated by `twin.py`; do not hand-edit.*

> Three-year integrated program: single-pass financial clearance redesign, then the eight-UC automation wave on the redesigned workflow, then attrition-based staffing capture across nine pools (~355 net FTE). Where SCN-01 and SCN-03 touch the same parameter, the later automation ramp carries the parameter further (effects compose sequentially).
